Teacher-guidance/technique registers, the O-Level register, meta/marketing videos and CIE 9990 psychology (no spine course — honest no-target) are excluded and ledgered as skips (310). Degenerate binds (generic-token-only evidence) were re-adjudicated to honest skips on review (2). Rejected/unrouted videos stay out of videos[].
